svg.aria-label: containers: Podman ate the disk. Get it back. Sub-skill podman: Windows, macOS and Linux, one stdlib script. Steps: Measure, what takes the space, first; Confirm, before anything is deleted; Prune, unused images; Trim, fstrim in the Podman machine; Compact, the WSL disk, on Windows. Output: the space is back on the host, and measured.
